title: Reliable chat sends and clearer night wording
summary: Fix chat send failures introduced by reply validation and make selected-night wording accurate when viewing today, the next roster night, or another date.
changes: Team and private chat sends no longer fail because reply validation recursively re-enters the chat message policy.
Once a message is saved, read-state or push-notification housekeeping can no longer make it appear unsent or create a false Retry item.
Your night now labels the assignment as Tonight, Current night, Next night or Selected night according to the date actually being viewed.
Changes, allocation, break guidance and night-only role wording now refer to the selected night instead of assuming the selected date is today.
Roster calculations, staffing rules, breaks, chat privacy, 14-day retention and notification preferences remain unchanged.
